_why: Some held cases ship with NO search term: nothing on the environment matched that field when the case was written, and the case says so ('YOU MUST FIND THE DATA YOURSELF'). A held case still has to be RUN and recorded, so the data was found or seeded and the term is recorded here. This file is an OVERRIDE, kept separate from entity-config.json so regenerating that from the live cases cannot silently drop it.

146253.how: Seeded 2026-09-29 on vendor 'ZZLONGROW Identical Name Supply' (adec7b7a-aab9-4c04-b073-3cd9b4268eff): contact ZZVENDCONTACT Delacroixson, Parts Manager, Preferred. The vendor had no contacts at all, so nothing could have matched. Created through the Add Contact form; Title and Department are both required and the form names them when they are missing.
